reason: 要旨: With the rising computational and monetary costs of training large language models (LLMs), checkpointing---periodically storing model states for recovery---becomes essential for fault tolerance. Conventional checkpointing entails a severe trade-off between checkpoint frequency (I/O overhead) and computational recovery。要旨上の主題は対象契約のLLM inference/serving効率、推論時圧縮に該当しない。
title: LayerCheck: Adaptive Layer-wise Checkpointing for Large Language Model Post-training
